<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court expansion:</strong> The Rajya Sabha passed a bill to increase the number of Supreme Court judges, though opposition members raised concerns regarding the ordinance route and judicial diversity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary logjam:</strong> Government and opposition leaders, including Kiren Rijiju and Rahul Gandhi, are engaged in talks to resolve ongoing disruptions in Parliament, while the INDIA bloc meets to finalize its strategy on key issues like the FCRA Bill and delimitation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxQa1Q4WWg1VFRCZ25UTG9DQmNiSlkyanVGTThTdUlxQnFzQkNvVU1xaHpKT2J4RkhqejFMS0pGbzlmTmhXa3BmRGE0WHluMjlWcF9aLVRpYjU4R01IVnhmVFdobktXR09jTGdtTkRwT1JfeGRjVWJNbUU3dFAzTFIzRHRlV3E?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> The Centre has revived its push for the Women’s Reservation Bill and delimitation, initiating outreach to the Congress party to build consensus.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE5rM3dXaldzSWd4WVVndEF2M3pxbV9CNlFCQ0MtTEY2eldpZDd1QjdSd2gxRG5YVzRVa29DVnhiRFJjc2xBMWxtUGd6TzdhVVAwTU8xMWxhWTdfRXhBMmFZb0ZDOUhoUW1KZm5HTQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
